function cloneTable(source)
local result = {}
for key, value in pairs(source or {}) do

end

end

function sortedCustomerIds(predicate)

result[#result + 1] = customerId
end
end

local bOrder = tonumber(CUSTOMERS[b].order) or math.huge
if aOrder == bOrder then
return a < b
end

end)
return result
end

local bOrder = tonumber(customerMap[b] and customerMap[b].order) or math.huge
if aOrder == bOrder then
return a < b
end
return aOrder < bOrder
end)

entries[#entries + 1] = entry
end

}

function normalizeCustomerRegistry(decoded)
if type(decoded) ~= "table" then
return nil, nil
end
local source = decoded.customers or decoded
if type(source) ~= "table" then
return nil, nil
end
local merged = {}
for customerId, data in pairs(FALLBACK_CUSTOMERS) do
merged[customerId] = cloneTable(data)
end
local accepted = 0
for _, entry in ipairs(source) do
if type(entry) == "table" then
local customerId = tostring(entry.id or ""):lower()
if customerId:match("^[a-z0-9_%-]+$") then
if entry.disabled == true then
merged[customerId] = nil
else
local normalized = cloneTable(merged[customerId])
for key, value in pairs(entry) do
if key ~= "id" and key ~= "disabled" then
normalized[key] = value
end
end
normalized.display_name = tostring(normalized.display_name or normalized.prompt_name or customerId)
normalized.prompt_name = tostring(normalized.prompt_name or normalized.display_name or customerId)
normalized.lore_comment = tostring(normalized.lore_comment or normalized.display_name or normalized.prompt_name)
normalized.asset_prefix = tostring(normalized.asset_prefix or customerId):lower()
normalized.order = tonumber(normalized.order) or 1000
normalized.initial_affection = tonumber(normalized.initial_affection) or 0
normalized.initial_trust = tonumber(normalized.initial_trust) or 0
merged[customerId] = normalized
end
accepted = accepted + 1
end
end
end
if accepted == 0 then
return nil, nil
end
return merged, customerRegistrySnapshotFromMap(merged)
end

function readCustomerRegistryLorebook(id)
local entries = getLoreBooks(id, CUSTOMER_REGISTRY_LORE_COMMENT) or {}
for index = #entries, 1, -1 do
local entry = entries[index]
if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.content) == "string" and entry.content:match("%S") then
local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, entry.content)
if ok then
local customerMap, snapshot = normalizeCustomerRegistry(decoded)
if customerMap and snapshot then
return customerMap, snapshot
end
end
end
end
return nil, nil
end

function syncCustomerRegistry(id, allowLorebookRead)
local customerMap = nil

customerMap, snapshot = readCustomerRegistryLorebook(id)

customerMap, snapshot = normalizeCustomerRegistry(cached)
end

customerMap = FALLBACK_CUSTOMERS
snapshot = customerRegistrySnapshotFromMap(customerMap)
end

rebuildCustomerIndexes(customerMap)
customerRegistrySignature = signature
end
